app.title: SilverStar Flight Controller Code Generator
column.name: Name
device.options_manifest_driven: Resource fields are built dynamically from plugin.json requirements. Current reference device manifests declare no additional editable option fields; the UI never branches on concrete sensor names.
dialog.plugin_remove_message: Remove installed plugin {name} ({id}) from the FCCG workspace? Project-owned copies are not deleted.
error.background_task_active: Another background task is already running.
error.documentation_open_failed: The operating system could not open the documentation directory.
error.plugin_builtin_readonly: {name} is a read-only builtin component and cannot be removed.
error.plugin_used_by_project: {name} is selected by the open project. Remove it from the project configuration before uninstalling it.
flight.source_ownership_notice: Flight Logic components belong to the embedded project after copying and may be freely edited; normal Apply Configuration never overwrites them.
generate.operation_count: The current change plan contains {count} component/file operations.
logging.thin_glue_notice: FCCG generates only project-level Record/Stream selection and decimation configuration; record definitions, serialization, endianness, and CRC belong to protocol component source.
page.algorithms.description: Select declarative Alignment, INS, and Estimator components and inspect capabilities and dependencies.
page.build.description: Detect the Arm GNU toolchain and provide unified Build, Clean, Host Tests, Architecture Check, Artifact Check, and Flash entry points.
page.devices.description: Select Device components, options, and required MCU / Board logical resources dynamically from plugin manifests.
page.flight.description: Select editable Flight Cycle, Deployment, Landing, and Recovery project components.
page.generate.description: Review validation, component diff plan, file operations, generated files, and warnings before any write.
page.logging.description: Select official Records / Streams, decimation, and rates while generating only thin project logging configuration.
page.mcu_board.description: Select MCU and Board plugins and inspect capabilities, allocation, and conflicts without building a full MCU pin solver.
page.plugins.description: Inspect, install, and validate declarative .ssplugin source packages without executing third-party code.
page.project.description: Create, open, and save SilverStar.ssproject and inspect the current firmware composition and validation state.
page.protocols.description: Inspect the complete SilverStar Protocol Bundle versions, capabilities, and official documentation.
placeholder.output_directory: Select a project output directory inside the FCCG workspace
plugin.execution_safety_notice: .ssplugin is a declarative source package. FCCG validates its manifest, paths, dependencies, capabilities, and conflicts, but never runs included Python, EXE, BAT, or PowerShell files.
plugin.export_future_tooltip: The data model and entry point are reserved; local-change comparison and new plugin export are implemented later.
project.ownership.summary: Copied component source belongs to the project and may be edited; only explicitly marked Generated Glue and project metadata are regenerated by FCCG.
protocol.full_bundle_notice: The first release copies the complete AIR, SSLOG, Maintenance, and other protocol source and formal documentation instead of exposing per-protocol disable switches.
status.backend_pending: The GUI is ready; this operation is implemented by application services after the completed reference firmware is loaded.
wizard.catalog_pending: Selections are supplied dynamically by installed declarative plugin manifests.
wizard.generate_summary: Finishing creates an in-memory draft. Preview Changes validates and shows the complete diff before any files are written.
wizard.step.algorithms.description: Select Alignment, INS, and Estimator components.
wizard.step.board.description: Select the board component and default logical resource mappings.
wizard.step.build.description: Select a build configuration and verify compiler, Make, Objcopy, Size, and flasher.
wizard.step.devices.description: Select device components and assign resources declared by their manifests.
wizard.step.flight.description: Select Flight Cycle, Deployment, Landing, and Recovery logic.
wizard.step.generate.description: Review the component plan and file operations before creating an independent project.
wizard.step.logging.description: Select Records / Streams and decimation configuration.
wizard.step.mcu.description: Select the MCU plugin and target toolchain capabilities.
wizard.step.project.description: Enter the project name, output directory, and target firmware version.
wizard.step.validation.description: Validate dependencies, capabilities, resources, toolchain, and the file plan.
wizard.validation_pending: Application services validate dependencies, capabilities, resources and the file plan before writing.
wizard.reference_logging: The complete SSLOG0 reference stream policy is preselected and remains editable on the Logging page.
wizard.reference_toolchain: The F407 reference uses Arm GNU GCC and authoritative Make; detection is available on the Build page.
wizard.reference_validation: The reference combination is validated when Preview Changes is selected; errors block Apply.
wizard.reference_generation: This creates the validated SilverStar F407 reference draft. Preview and explicit confirmation are required before Apply.
dialog.apply_plan_message: Apply the validated change plan shown on the Generate page? Project-owned component source will be preserved.
dialog.flash_message: Flashing changes connected hardware. Continue only after configuring FLASH_COMMAND and FLASH_ARGS for the intended target.
error.no_project: Create or open a project first.
error.plan_invalid: The change plan is invalid. Resolve validation errors before Apply.

status.plugin_removing: Removing installed plugin from the workspace…

page.board_hardware.description: Auto-assign Board resources from selected Device needs; expand advanced mapping or import custom STM32 hardware only when needed.
page.flight_configuration.description: Configure alignment, INS, estimation, landing, calibration, deployment triggers, and logging.
device.resources_next_step: Device plugins declare requirements only. Map UART, SPI, GPIO, and other resources on the next Board & Hardware page.
board.no_provider: No manual hardware provider is available for this MCU. Install a Board plugin.
board.cubemx_steps: 1. Configure peripherals in CubeMX; 2. Generate Code; 3. Return to FCCG and import the .ioc or complete project.
board.automatic_summary: Board compatibility and default mappings were resolved from selected Device requirements.
board.advanced_explanation: Default mappings normally need no changes; edit only Board-declared legal alternatives.
wizard.identity_summary: Enter project identity and MCU; continue through the six main pages for configuration.
dialog.custom_hardware_risk_message: Custom hardware is not officially validated by SilverStar. Verify clocks, DMA, interrupts, GPIO electrical levels, and power. Continue importing?
dialog.dangerous_changes_message: These operations deactivate components or overwrite manually changed managed/hardware files. Review the diff before continuing.
dialog.close_active_task: A background task is running. Cancel it and close?
